usage: 遠 (jyun5) describes a long physical distance between two places or objects.
It can also be used metaphorically to indicate a distant relationship or a time far in the past or future.
遠 often appears before nouns to describe how far something is, for example, 遠路 (a long journey).
When used in questions, it asks about the distance or how far something is.
遠 can also be combined with measurement words to specify exact distances.

examples.meaning: This shopping mall is very far.
